headline_seed: Senate Passes Stopgap Bill to Avert Shutdown, Avoiding Skirmish Before Midterms - The New York Times
draft_text:
The Senate passed a stopgap spending bill 90-6 early Saturday, funding the government through Dec. 11 and pushing the shutdown deadline past November's midterms. Politico and NBC News both confirm the bill now heads to the House.

And that's the mews.
